scope: Sample attribution only. Same page and process share heaps/GC; independent same-byte package module and WASM instances. Leaf language and role categories are disjoint. Inclusive groups overlap and are not additive; union categories de-duplicate ancestors. HTTP .wasm frames count as WASM even when V8 uses the other package URL for shared compiled code. Regex symbol coverage and inlining limit attribution. Samples do not prove allocation counts or call frequency. Profiler throughput is not the latency acceptance benchmark.
